service.ur: شہریوں کے لیے خاندانی ڈیٹا کا اجراء

about: Create a new family record for a UAE citizen, for example after a first marriage.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Issue family data (citizens). Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For UAE citizens: first-time marriage, a divorced or widowed woman, or an unmarried person aged 30 or over
A marriage contract issued abroad must be translated into Arabic and attested by the UAE embassy and Ministry of Foreign Affairs
A citizen spouse in the armed forces or a similar body needs a no-objection letter to marry a foreign spouse
A widow gets a new record only if no children are registered under the late husband's record
Complete any changes ICP asks for if the application is returned
documents: Personal photo and marriage certificate when both spouses are citizens
If one spouse is not a citizen: both birth certificates, latest education certificates and a to-whom-it-may-concern letter from both employers
A marriage continuity certificate when the contract was issued abroad or is over a year old
Sharia court status declaration for a divorced woman, a widow, an unmarried person aged 30 or over, or an unemployed husband
fees: Application fee for issuing family data 50 AED
timing: Smart services run 24/7; service centres keep their working hours
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
